name: RE 2020 — Environmental Regulation for New Buildings
description: Validates project documentation against RE 2020 (Reglementation Environnementale 2020) requirements for new buildings. Checks that the energy performance indicators (Bbio, Cep, Cep_nr), carbon footprint thresholds (Ic_construction, Ic_energie), and summer comfort (DH degree-hours) are documented and within the regulatory limits for the declared building type and climate zone.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
